setup: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA uqa_coverage_92fe478a8650 TO uqa_coverage_reader_92fe478a8650;
CREATE TABLE coverage_input(id integer, secret text);
GRANT SELECT(id) ON coverage_input TO uqa_coverage_reader_92fe478a8650;
CREATE VIEW coverage_owner_view AS SELECT id, secret FROM coverage_input;
CREATE VIEW coverage_invoker_view WITH (security_invoker=true) AS SELECT id, secret FROM coverage_input;
GRANT SELECT ON coverage_owner_view, coverage_invoker_view TO uqa_coverage_reader_92fe478a8650;
CREATE FUNCTION coverage_definer() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER AS 'SELECT secret FROM coverage_input WHERE id = 1';
CREATE FUNCTION coverage_invoker() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql SECURITY INVOKER AS 'SELECT secret FROM coverage_input WHERE id = 1';

cases.sql: SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM coverage_input OFFSET 0) AS inner_input OFFSET 0) AS derived ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM (SELECT id, secret FROM coverage_input OFFSET 0) AS derived ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM coverage_input WHERE secret = 'one' OFFSET 0) AS derived
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT FROM coverage_input OFFSET 0) AS derived
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM coverage_input OFFSET 0) AS derived
WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM coverage_input) SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM c OFFSET 0) AS derived ORDER BY id
WITH c AS (SELECT secret FROM coverage_input) SELECT secret FROM (SELECT secret FROM c OFFSET 0) AS derived
SELECT p.id, d.value FROM coverage_input AS p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.id + 1 AS value OFFSET 0) AS d ORDER BY p.id
SELECT d.value FROM coverage_input AS p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.secret AS value OFFSET 0) AS d
SELECT secret FROM (SELECT secret FROM coverage_owner_view OFFSET 0) AS derived ORDER BY secret
SELECT secret FROM (SELECT secret FROM coverage_invoker_view OFFSET 0) AS derived
SELECT value FROM (SELECT coverage_definer() AS value OFFSET 0) AS derived
SELECT value FROM (SELECT coverage_invoker() AS value OFFSET 0) AS derived
